''See also: [[Highgold Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Highgold represents a significant stage of [[advancement]] within the [[Gold]] progression of [[sacred arts]]. Positioned between [[Lowgold]] and [[Truegold]], it is characterized by a specific density of [[madra]] and the presence of a [[Goldsign]], which serves as a visual indicator of an individual's [[Path]]. Reaching this level is a rare feat, with some estimates suggesting only one in a thousand [[Lowgold|Lowgolds]] successfully advances to Highgold. At this stage, practitioners often begin to inherit insights and skills from the [[Remnants]] they have bonded with. While some achieve this status by breaking down their [[Remnant]] for power, others follow different methods to expand their [[madra]] base. Highgolds are considered impressive and formidable combatants; they possess enough strength to be used as guards, servants, or teammates in organized squads. However, the gap between Highgold and the subsequent [[Truegold]] stage is vast, reflecting the increasing difficulty of [[advancement]] as one climbs the ranks toward [[Underlord]].}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Highgold represents a specific level of strength and status that sits above the rank of [[Lowgold]]. Within the [[Five Factions Alliance]], it functions as a recognized group or status, serving as an [[advancement]] stage that only one in every thousand [[Lowgold|Lowgolds]] manages to reach. Achieving a perfect [[Iron body]] serves as a guarantee for this power stage, which is also recognized as a formal rank or title. [[Jai Long]] currently holds the Highgold rank, though it is a stage he will no longer occupy within a year.}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Highgold is a classification of entity that includes individuals like [[Jade]] and serves as a specific rank within the [[Jai clan]]. As a developmental stage situated above [[Lowgold]], this level can be reached by cracking open a [[Remnant]]. While [[Yerin]] possesses the potential to reach Highgold by letting go of her [[Remnant]], she finds herself stuck at its boundary. This barrier can be broken through the application of sufficient [[sword madra]], and [[Lindon]] eventually kills a Highgold.}}

== Ghostwater ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Highgold represents a specific stage of power and density, serving as an [[advancement]] level on the [[Path of Black Flame]]. Within certain habitats, this designation identifies a specific type of fish that exerts pressure equivalent to the stage itself. A single glass of [[Spirit Well]] is capable of bringing a Highgold to the very brink of further [[advancement]]. This classification also applies to a group or entity capable of operating [[launcher construct|launcher constructs]], as well as a specific type of [[dragon]].}}

== Underlord ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Within the [[Skysworn]], Highgold represents a specific rank that [[Yerin]] maintains as her second core. In the [[Blackflame Empire]] camp, [[Mercy]] reached this stage and was accompanied by a young Highgold man wielding a [[Forged]] [[sword]] of pale light. While many hundreds or thousands of individuals have transitioned from Highgold to [[Truegold]], the rank remains inferior to that of an [[Underlord]]. In this stage, Highgolds typically reside in small groups within tents, and those at the peak of the rank possess purple crystalline armor and the pressure of a peak [[Truegold]].}}
